blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence through three bounded implementation families: repair automatic lantern attack audio causality, qualify dense native-renderer performance, and complete the ordinary run/result/retry, choice-presentation, and authored-arena spatial contracts.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release-convergence evidence shows two active defects: automatic combat Effects output is silent or lacks source-event alignment, and the dense profile has no native-renderer timing qualification. The complete-run release contract also needs an explicit lifecycle/spatial pass for host recapture.

stop_conditions: Preserve the intact authored cemetery package, retained Warden Skeleton3D/AnimationPlayer hierarchy, authoritative lantern attack/hit/death-drop/dash ownership, and retained component audio sources.
Do not schedule deferred camera-occlusion or exposure issues as separate work items.
Stop implementation after these three bounded tasks; host and Tester own recapture, formal verdicts, and issue closure.

strategy.rationale: Use materially different root-cause strategies: isolate and repair the product audio adapter and envelopes; add bounded native-renderer qualification around the real dense lifecycle; and make authoritative run/result/retry transitions plus arena collision and visibility contracts explicit. Each family is independently retestable.

code: Run existing project checks plus focused static/unit checks for attack-report ownership and routing, lifecycle reset idempotence, tester_* release guards, dense threshold serialization, and truthful choice-value rules.
Verify the preserved authored cemetery package, Warden Skeleton3D/AnimationPlayer hierarchy, authoritative lantern state ownership, and retained audio sources remain intact.
runtime: Host/Tester recapture all three required gaps in one session: automatic-attack mixed output plus source timeline; native dense-profile timing/count/error receipts across reset-isolated cycles; and three successful run-to-Result-to-Retry cycles with reset receipts and HUD/build/reward state.
Re-run preserved host_godot_boot and native_godot_project validations.
visual: Capture gameplay HUD/upgrade, Result/Retry, and authored-cemetery spawn, route, landmark, and perimeter viewpoints at the acceptance resolution.

Verify silhouette/icon hierarchy, truthful current-to-new deltas, focus states, readable arena framing, external depth, collision/visibility during ordinary movement, and no landmark disappearance or occlusion.

done_when: Each automatic lantern attack produces exactly one short, recognizable attack transient in the mixed Effects output, with source-event timestamps proving causality.

Lantern onset, miss, concrete-hit, character-hit, and enemy-spatial cues are isolated; generic bolt VFX never replays the complete player report, and long impact ringing cannot mask the attack transient.
If reliable world-surface material tags are unavailable, world-surface impact audio is disabled while impact VFX and character-hit feedback remain.
A same-session Tester replay can inspect the isolated stems and combined mix, including release and lifecycle-reset stopping behavior.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authoritative automatic-attack report at the product adapter/audio layer. Inspect the existing lantern runtime, attack runtime, and audio director; isolate player onset, miss, concrete-hit, character-hit, and enemy-spatial stems; enforce one bounded transient per legal attack and stop playback on release/reset. Preserve existing weapon identity, targeting, hit/death causality, and authored assets. Add only candidate-owned source-event/timeline instrumentation needed for host recapture.
tasks.title: Repair automatic combat audio causality

done_when: The normal project path launches a native-renderer dense profile at representative 1920x1080 resolution using a bounded deterministic scenario that exercises real enemy, projectile, pickup, and VFX lifecycles.
The sample emits frame-time/FPS, physics/render samples, active enemy/projectile/VFX counts, allocation or growth signals, runtime errors, and explicit threshold pass/fail fields.

Across three reset-isolated dense cycles the scenario remains playable without stalls, runaway growth, invalid-node errors, or post-reset leaks; qualification instrumentation is debug-gated and does not alter ordinary release pacing or HUD behavior.
Tester has a same-session replay recipe and source-visible counters for direct retest.
tasks.instructions: Implement a bounded native-renderer qualification path around the existing wave director and dense profile. Use the real spawn, movement, combat, pickup, and VFX lifecycle rather than a synthetic loop; sample timing and active counts deterministically; serialize threshold results and reset receipts for host/Tester review. Keep the path isolated from ordinary release behavior and avoid broad renderer or asset replacement.
tasks.title: Qualify dense profile on native renderer

done_when: An ordinary successful route completes five escalating waves, including an elite encounter and Bellkeeper boss, then reaches an authoritative Result state showing summary statistics, build identity, reward feedback, and Retry.

Retry resets enemies, timers, XP/upgrades, audio, overlays, HUD, and counters exactly once; three consecutive success-to-Result-to-Retry cycles show no stale actors, duplicate audio, stuck UI, or leaked state.

Upgrade and weapon choices lead with recognizable silhouettes/icons, show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, omit unchanged or placeholder CURRENT values, and expose distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/activation states.

The intact authored cemetery provides larger traversable scale, coherent external world/external depth, a visible central building/landmark, aligned collision, no disappearance/occlusion during ordinary movement/movement replay, and a stable boundary/perimeter.

Isolated tester_* prepare and explicit advance/commit hooks expose branch id, setup generation, requested/resolved/reset receipts and release-build guards for Result and Retry checks; these hooks are unavailable in release exports.
tasks.instructions: Make success, reward/build presentation, Result, and Retry authoritative transitions with clean teardown and reinitialization, then add non-shipping tester_* preparation/advance hooks for direct branch checks. Rebase spawn, objective, collision, navigation, and boundary checks onto the intact authored cemetery so movement replay proves larger traversable scale, external depth, central building landmark visibility, collision alignment, no disappearance or occlusion, and coherent perimeter boundary. Implement the required choice visual hierarchy and complete focus states on the existing HUD; do not duplicate or surgically alter authored meshes or preserved character/audio assets.
tasks.title: Complete run, retry, spatial, and choice contracts
